preconditions.description: The number of stones is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each stone has edges with lengths between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: All(i in chosen_stones for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The chosen stones are numbered from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: max_volume == max(calculate_volume(a, b, c) for a, b, c in possible_sizes)
postconditions.description: The chosen stones form the largest possible volume of a sphere that Kostya can carve.

invariants.description: The possible sizes for the glued stones are either 2 or 3.

invariants.expression: all(a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a for a, b, c in possible_sizes)
invariants.description: The possible sizes must form a valid triangle.

invariants.expression: all(a <= max(b, c) and b <= max(a, c) and c <= max(a, b) for a, b, c in possible_sizes)
invariants.description: The possible sizes must be valid edge lengths for a rectangular parallelepiped.
